description.en: Sets a temporary, non-persistent byte-sized value (not just a single bit, unlike CMND_SET_TEMP_BIT_FLAG), identified by a numeric index. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Index of the temporary byte value to set.

example.code:
// Store a small counter value that doesn't need to persist
CMND_SET_TEMP_BYTE_FLAG(0, 3);
